title: Bottom is thick, sides are thin.
text:
Bottom is thick, sides are thin.. This is a nice looking Emeril Lagasse stainless copper core pan. Even though this says its a Emeril Lagasse pan, its a registered trademark of Martha Stewart living Omnimedia, Inc.! Made in China.
Since this is stainless it is a healthy pan ..(non-stick is not healthy,unless ceramic)

In the middle of the base of the pan, there is the thin ring of copper.I think that is suppose to be the main selling point of this pan!
Handle is riveted to the pan which is a plus. There are No screws to get loose.
On the stove top, the handle did not get hot. I cooked on a med low heat.
I think the reason the handle did not get hot is, the Split handle, and the Side of this
Pan are THIN, Which is not good!

This pan can be used on a “Induction” stove top, and all other types stovetops.

The top of the pan measure across 10 1/2 inch.
The Bottom of the flat inside part of the pan is, 7 1/2 inch.
2 1/4 inch deep..Handle is 7 1/4 long, although handle attaches to the under side rim of pan.

I used this pan to Sauté veggies , then put 3 eggs on top using organic coconut oil.
I kept the flame on med-low, to low. Put a silicon lid on the top, and I had to add allot more coconut oil, so the veggies would not stick!.
It still did!

The weight of the pan comes from the bottom. The bottom of the food cooked even, but as I said the sides are thin, did not get as hot as they should have and took a long time to cook veggies and eggs!!

When I took the eggs etc. out of pan, I let the pan cool, then added kitchen soap and hot water, cause the veggies stuck to the bottom.
I waited about 15 mins, hand washed the pan with soap and kitchen brush, and it looked awful..
I had to use Bar Keepers Friend, and the rough side of the sponge, and then the pan was clean, look like new again.
I do not put any of my cookware in the dishwasher.

The main reason I wanted this pan was, it can go into the oven at 550 degrees, and I could finish off a Steak
in the oven with butter on top.
I have to admit I have not used it for that yet.

I have heavy grates on my gas stove top.
I have never had the sides of a pan not cook very good (these are thin), and it does not matter if its expensive pan or Not.
I Do not like that the food stuck on the bottom, even when I had put in so much coconut oil, although its healthy..!

3 stars. I was expecting more from this pan.

product_metadata.title: Emeril Lagasse Stainless Steel Copper Core Fry Pan, 8-Inch, 8", Silver
features: Encapsulated aluminum base with copper core for exceptional heat distribution
Safe for all stovetops, including induction
Riveted stainless steel handles go from stovetop to oven, safe to 550°f
description: In my Emeril Lagasse stainless steel with copper core cookware you have the beauty of stainless steel with the added bonus of an aluminum base bottom surrounding a copper core. This means that the cooking surface heats up quickly and the heat is exceptionally well-distributed. These pots and pans are also ready to go from either conventional or induction stovetops straight to the oven and then for quick clean up, they are dishwasher-safe. Tempered glass lids make it easy to monitor cooking without lifting the lid and losing precious steam. Perhaps my favorite feature about this set, however, is the pour spouts and straining lids which work together to allow draining of cooking liquids without removing the lids. This 8 inch fry pan is perfect for frying or scrambling eggs or cooking a grilled cheese sandwich for one.
